title: Automated Technical Support Knowledge Base
business: Enterprise software companies managing vast repositories of technical documentation and troubleshooting guides.
problem: Support agents struggle to manually locate specific configuration steps within thousands of documents, leading to inconsistent resolution times and high operational costs.
solution: Implementing a RAG-based retrieval system using Vector Search to perform semantic similarity matching against technical documentation, allowing the LLM to ground responses in verified internal knowledge.
steps: Upload technical documentation to a Cloud Storage bucket to trigger a Pub/Sub message.
Use a Cloud Run function to parse documents into smaller, manageable text chunks.
Generate embeddings for these chunks via the Agent Platform Embeddings API.
Build and deploy a Vector Search index to store and serve these embeddings.
Configure a backend Cloud Run service to retrieve relevant chunks based on user query embeddings.
outcome: Support agents receive contextually accurate, grounded answers to complex technical queries, significantly reducing the time spent searching through static documentation.
limitation: Vector Search relies on semantic similarity, which may retrieve irrelevant content if the query is ambiguous; verify accuracy by monitoring the relevance of retrieved grounding data against the generated LLM response.

questions.question: In Automated Technical Support Knowledge Base, how does the system address the problem of slow manual document searching?
options: By using Vector Search to perform semantic similarity matching against technical documentation.
By replacing all human support agents with fully autonomous chatbots.
By storing all documentation in a relational database for keyword-based filtering.
By manually tagging every document with metadata for faster retrieval.
questions.explanation: The solution leverages Vector Search to perform semantic similarity matching, which allows the system to find relevant information based on meaning rather than just keywords.

questions.question: In Automated Technical Support Knowledge Base, what is a primary limitation of the retrieval process?
options: The system cannot handle more than ten documents at a time.
Vector Search may retrieve irrelevant content if the query is ambiguous.
The system requires manual indexing for every new user query.
The system is incompatible with Cloud Run services.
